GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   B. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   D. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

5. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   C. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   B. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   D. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   D. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Nairobi

4. C — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Plan income and spending wisely

7. D — Explain symbols used on a map

8. D — Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
